title: Wrong-Cushion Reship Period and Time to Handling (PAP Supply Replenishment Program)
content:
**Provision.** For a no-charge reship of the fitting cushion item in the PAP Supply Replenishment Program, the months of the reship are counted from a start date to the replaced line's covered-through date, and how they are counted depends on when the error is handled, measured in calendar days from the day the replaced line shipped to the handling day:

| Days from the replaced line's ship date to handling | How the months are counted |
|---|---|
| 31 to 90 | only the whole calendar months from the start date to the replaced line's covered-through date count, with no month added for the month the start date falls in |
| more than 90 | no months count |
| 30 or fewer | no change under this provision |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, replaced line shipped 1 March)

- Handled 31 March (30 days): no change under this provision.
- Handled 1 April (31 days): only the whole calendar months count.
- Handled 30 May (90 days): only the whole calendar months count.
- Handled 31 May (91 days): no months count.

## Worked example (hypothetical)

Start date 15 April, replaced line covered through 31 May, handled 45 days after the line shipped: the whole calendar months from 15 April to 31 May are 1, and 1 month counts.

## Points of judgement

- The day count runs from the replaced line's ship date, not from the date the patient reported the error.
- More than 90 days after the replaced line shipped, no months of the replaced line's period count.
